class.name: JRPGControlSwitchesCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: turns one switch or a range of switches ON or OFF.
class.description: Sets switches [member first_id] to [member last_id] ON or OFF ([member value]); one switch when both are the same. A range outside 1 to [constant JRPGGameState.MAX_SWITCH_ID], or backwards, changes nothing, with a warning. Authority: server.

members.member: The last switch: the same as [member first_id] for one switch.
